I was in my first job, as a reporter in a business newspaper. I remember a male colleague looked at my new dress and used a nasty word to describe that I looked good. #MeToo #MahilaBol #PinTheCreep
When I moved on from that organisation my immediate boss touched my dangling ears and felt it down my neck. I froze. I was young and naive. #MahilaBol #PinTheCreep #MeToo

Soon he put his hand on my thigh one day and moved it up my thigh while editing my copy. I closed my laptop and ran from there. Thankfully the big boss there stood up for me. #MeToo #PinTheCreep #MahilaBol
He was soon asked to leave. But another senior editor, he wanted to know all the details as to where I was touched by my immediate boss. #MeToo #MahilaBol #PinTheCreep
